title: [review] project-LICHEN-2auf.44.11.1.1: build_context_2/3 omit C_R and TH from MAC computation
description:
The new `build_context_2` and `build_context_3` signatures accept `C_R` and `TH` parameters but the implementations ignore them (prefixed with `_`). 

Per RFC 9528:
- §6.2: context_2 = << C_R, ID_CRED_R, TH_2, CRED_R, ? EAD_2 >>
- §6.3: context_3 = << ID_CRED_I, TH_3, CRED_I, ? EAD_3 >>

Current implementation at `rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs:485-497` computes only << ID_CRED, CRED >> for both contexts. The new signatures are correct (adding the missing parameter slots) but the function bodies still omit `C_R` and `TH_x` from the CBOR sequence. This will cause EDHOC interop failures against other RFC-compliant implementations.
